verdict.rationale: The evidence offers developer building blocks rather than a documented rule-based automation feature. C++ delegates can call a function "at a future time", Blueprints provide general scripting, Python automates editor tasks, and Remote Control presets emit WebSocket events that clients can subscribe to. None of these is documented as a way to define rules that automatically trigger actions on events, so they earn no credit under the building-block and adjacent-feature rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
